app.title: Magic Workshop
audio.title: Sound
audio.description: Music and sound effects. Settings are saved on this device.
help.heat: Select the cauldron: V (1) increases fire, square (2) reduces it, circle (5) stirs. The stirring meter slowly falls.
help.ingredients: Select a coloured cube and draw a vertical line (3) to lift it. Move it to the cauldron centre. A horizontal line (4) drops it. Match recipe colours, temperature and stirring range.
help.rules: Finish timed missions before zero. Mistakes cost points. Reward: base stones × stars. Esc abandons the mission.
hud.enemies: Click an enemy: blue — V (fire), yellow — square (cold).
result.debug: Debug run: rewards and achievements are disabled.
messages.enemySelected: Enemy selected: blue — V, yellow — square.
messages.full: Both corners are occupied. Defeat an enemy first.
messages.spawned: Debug enemy spawned; rewards disabled until the next run.
messages.wrongSpell: Wrong spell: blue — V, yellow — square.
messages.wrongTemperature: Wrong temperature: adjust the fire and wait.
training.title: Spell lessons
training.intro: Training is optional. Successfully trace each of the 10 spells twice.
training.start: Start at the golden dot and trace the pattern in one stroke.
training.direction: Start at the golden dot and follow the arrow.
training.mastered: Spell mastered! Continue to the next one or keep practicing.
training.again: Correct! Repeat this spell once more.
training.failed: Not quite. Trace the entire pattern from start to finish in one stroke.
training.cleared: Canvas cleared. Trace the pattern again.

shop.title: Shop
shop.intro: Wands, cauldrons, crystals and ready-made potions. Buy a permanent item, then select Equip; potions go straight into your inventory.
shop.wandDescription: A colored wand. Spell power stays the same.
shop.potDescription: A new cauldron color. Brewing is unaffected.
shop.purchased: Purchased! Select Equip to use it.
slime.spells: Spells needed to defeat the slime
messages.slimeSelected: Slime selected. Cast the three shown gestures in any order.
messages.slimePresent: A slime is already present. Defeat it first.
messages.slimeWrong: That gesture is not among the slime’s remaining symbols.
messages.slimeBlocked: The slime blocks the cauldron! Select it and cast the remaining symbols.
arena.title: Crystal Defense
arena.entry: Choose at least three different potions. Upgrade slots and uses in the shop.
arena.inventoryHint: Basic bottles are consumed first, then fine and masterwork. Higher quality gives stronger effects. Extra uses keep the original bottle's quality.
arena.entryError: Check your selected potions and stock; the run must not have started.
arena.instructions: Select a bottle and throw with a vertical line. Counters: fire/giant—square, frost—V, slime—Z, sentinel—V/square/Z. Lift ordinary ground cubes with vertical (3), move the pointer and drop with horizontal (4), without damage. Giants and flyers cannot be carried. On the crystal, square clears fire, V clears frost; circle (5) disorients three nearby enemies when surrounded. Any gesture detonates a purple cube, damaging only enemies. P pauses.
arena.coinRules: Enemy rewards and the wave bonus are temporary. Next banks them. The coin risks only this amount: spiral ×2, bones 0. Stones are banked when the coin stops. Defeat or exit loses unbanked rewards; your previous balance stays safe.
arena.cleanse: Select crystal: cold removes fire, fire removes frost.
arena.projectile: Slow charge: select it, then draw square against fire or V against frost.
arena.projectileIntercept: Select the charge and draw its counterspell
arena.selectTarget: Click an enemy, a slow charge or the crystal.
arena.wrongSpell: Check the target rune: square against fire/giants, V against frost, Z against slime; sentinels accept V, square or Z.
arena.coinHint: Coin selected. Draw any gesture, such as a vertical line. Click again to cancel.
arena.coinWin: Spiral! This wave's stones doubled and banked.
arena.coinLose: Bones: this wave's temporary stones were lost.
arena.throwHeal: Draw a vertical line to throw the potion onto the table.
arena.potionHint: Draw a vertical line to throw the potion onto the table.
arena.potionGesture: Draw a vertical line to throw the potion onto the table.
arena.potionSelected: Potion selected. A vertical stroke throws it; clicking another object cancels selection.
arena.potionFlying: The potion is flying onto the table. Its effect starts when it shatters.
arena.fullHealth: Crystal is already at full health. Potion not consumed.
arena.buffActive: Potion shattered: its field effect applied and its cast buff is active temporarily.
arena.debug: Debug run: no new stones or cards awarded.
potions.frost.name: Frost Potion
potions.frost.description: On impact, freezes all current enemies for {{impactDuration}} s. For {{duration}} s, hits also freeze targets for {{onHitDuration}} s.
potions.flame.name: Flame Potion
potions.flame.description: On impact, burns all current enemies for {{impactDuration}} s at {{dps}} damage/s. For {{duration}} s, hits also burn targets for {{onHitDuration}} s.
potions.echo.name: Echo Potion
potions.echo.description: After impact, adds fire, frost, levitation and lightning to gestures for {{duration}} s. Up to {{targets}} targets within {{chainRadius}} units.
potions.healing.name: Healing Potion
potions.healing.description: On impact, restores {{heal}} crystal HP, up to its maximum.
cards.1.name: Alba, Keeper of Sparks
cards.1.description: The first spark is no stronger than the rest; it simply does not fear the dark. Alba taught young mages to defend what they cherished.
cards.2.name: Niv, Master of Frost
cards.2.description: Niv stopped avalanches with a gesture and never mistook cold for cruelty. His lesson: cool anger before you act.
cards.3.name: Orin Copperstaff
cards.3.description: Orin forged his staff from an old cauldron. He believed patience mattered more than rare materials.
cards.4.name: Mira the Herbalist
cards.4.description: Mira always carried a healing potion. She taught that a saved ally is worth more than a beautiful spell.
cards.5.name: Selene, Weaver of Echoes
cards.5.description: Selene heard echoes of words not yet spoken. Her magic joined several voices into one spell.
cards.6.name: Pharos Stormcaller
cards.6.description: Pharos did not command storms; he listened to their rhythm. His lightning never struck twice without reason.
cards.7.name: Liora, Crystal Guardian
cards.7.description: Liora guarded the crystal for seven nights. Her shield was sustained by a promise never to retreat.
cards.8.name: Elian of Two Faces
cards.8.description: Elian carried a coin holding two destinies. Fortune favors the bold, but never returns lost time.
cards.9.name: Astra, Mistress of Tides
cards.9.description: Astra turned heat to ice and ice to mist. Opposites were merely two pages of the same book.
cards.10.name: The Grand Archivist
cards.10.description: The Archivist recorded those who reached the tenth wave. His book now has a place for your victory.
cheats.title: Cheat trainer
cheats.hint: F10 opens/closes; Esc closes without leaving the game. Gameplay and timers continue. Grey buttons are unavailable in this mode.
cheats.rewards: Spawning enemies or skipping stages/waves disables rewards for the current run. Enemy limits still apply.
cheats.failed: Could not execute: {{name}}. Check enemy limits and game state.
brewing.lift: Lift: select a cube and draw a vertical line
brewing.ignite: Select the cauldron and draw V to light the fire
brewing.stir: Select the cauldron and draw a circle to stir
messages.wrongStirring: This ingredient needs a different stirring level. Check its range.
firstVisit.welcome: Welcome! You received one fine potion of each of the four types to try Crystal Defense. Stones: 0.
brewing.cool: Select the cauldron and draw a square to lower the heat
arena.coinTossing: The coin is falling and bouncing. Waiting for the result.
shop.arenaEffects: Wand combat effects apply only in Crystal Defense. Cauldron and crystal colors are cosmetic.
shop.crystalDescription: A new crystal color for the arena. Health and protection stay the same.
shop.wandDamageDescription: Adds {{damageBonus}} damage to a valid enemy hit in the arena. Brewing is unaffected.
shop.wandExecutionDescription: A valid enemy hit in the arena has a {{chance}}% chance to kill instantly. Giants still split.
shop.wandSplashDescription: A valid hit on the selected enemy also deals {{percent}}% damage to neighbors within {{radius}}, regardless of their element. With Echo, each target takes damage once.
shop.wandNoobDescription: In the arena, any recognized gesture becomes the right spell for the selected enemy, slow charge, crystal cleansing or potion use. Target selection and spell cooldowns still apply. It cannot intercept fast charges.
shop.potionPurchased: One potion purchased and added to your inventory.
arena.wandInstantKill: The wand instantly defeated the enemy.
arena.wandAutoCounter: The wand selected the right spell.
bestiary.title: Bestiary and items
bestiary.intro: Select an entry to inspect its model and interactions. Gestures assume a normal wand without Echo: Echo, automatic counters and splash damage can change crystal-defense rules.
bestiary.empty: No entries in this category yet.
messages.slimeCooldown: A slime can appear in {{seconds}} seconds.
bestiary.enemycold: The workshop frost spirit occupies an upper corner and fires cooling bolts at the cauldron.
bestiary.enemyfire: The workshop fire spirit occupies an upper corner and fires heating bolts at the cauldron.
bestiary.enemyslime: Slides to the cauldron and blocks it, heating and ingredient handling. It does not shoot. After its defeat, another slime must wait at least {{cooldown}} seconds of game time.
bestiary.enemyInteraction: Click the enemy first, then draw one of the listed gestures.
bestiary.brewingWrong: Other gestures do not dispel this spirit. Defeating it does not remove bolts already in flight.
bestiary.slimeInteraction: Each slime has three distinct random gestures out of ten. Select it and cast exactly its three remaining icons in any order. The list below shows the full possible pool.
bestiary.slimeWrong: A gesture absent from the remaining icons does not help. Repeating a cleared icon has no effect. Cauldron actions are unavailable while the slime blocks it.
bestiary.arena.fire: A fire cube approaches the crystal, enters rage and may ignite it. After a hit it may recoil or become disoriented.
bestiary.arena.frost: A frost cube quickly approaches the crystal, enters rage and may inflict a damaging frost effect.
bestiary.arena.moss: The arena moss slime deals strong melee hits and extra damage. It needs Z, unlike the workshop slime with three random gestures.
bestiary.arena.giant: A large slow cube with high health. On death it splits into two standard fire cubes that continue the attack.
bestiary.arena.flyerFire: A flying fire cube circles the crystal and fires very slow fire bolts. Each bolt can be selected and destroyed separately.
bestiary.arena.flyerFrost: A flying frost cube circles the crystal and fires very slow frost bolts. Bolts remain after their shooter dies.
bestiary.arena.sentinel: The glowing red cube is usually neutral. It sometimes counts down from five, then fires a fast, unblockable low-damage bolt. A damaging gesture interrupts its preparation.
bestiary.arenaWrong: Other gestures do no direct damage on their own. Giants, flying enemies and moss slimes cannot be lifted. Echo and the beginner wand can supply a counterspell; burning and splash damage to neighbors act separately.
bestiary.cauldronDescription: The workshop’s main object. It accepts recipe ingredients only at the correct temperature and agitation.
bestiary.cauldronInteraction: Select the cauldron: V (1) increases heat, square (2) lowers it, circle (5) stirs. Wait for the required temperature; agitation gradually settles.
bestiary.cauldronWrong: Other gestures do not control heat or stirring. While a slime blocks the cauldron, these actions and adding ingredients are unavailable.
bestiary.ingredientDescription: A recipe material. Follow its color, name and the next step; similarly shaped ingredients are not interchangeable.
bestiary.ingredientInteraction: Select the ingredient, lift with a vertical line (3), and move it to the cauldron. A horizontal line (4) cancels carrying. Successful addition grants {{bonus}} seconds to a timed mission.
bestiary.ingredientWrong: A click alone does not carry an ingredient. A wrong ingredient, temperature or agitation does not advance the recipe or grant time.
bestiary.potionInteraction: Select a rim bottle and draw a vertical line (3). Effects apply when it shatters; higher quality strengthens them. Shop upgrades add slots and uses.
bestiary.potionWrong: Other gestures do not throw the selected potion, except with the novice wand’s automatic counter. Clicking elsewhere deselects without spending it. Healing is not spent at full health.
bestiary.crystalDescription: The arena's defense target. Burning and frost deal damage over time. The model left of the potions shows its conditions and counterspells. Wave settings control HP recovery; by default, waves 9 and 10 start without recovery.
bestiary.crystalInteraction: Select the main crystal or its rim model. Square (2) clears burning; V (1) clears frost. If at least {{minimum}} enemies are within {{radius}} units, circle (5) disorients the {{count}} nearest for {{duration}} s; cooldown {{cooldown}} s. Healing potions restore HP.
bestiary.crystalWrong: Other gestures do not cleanse or heal by themselves. Circle needs nearby enemies and a ready spell. Echo and the beginner wand can add cleansing; crystal colors do not improve defense.
bestiary.coinInteraction: After a wave, select the coin and cast any recognized gesture. Click again to cancel selection. When the coin stops, this wave's temporary reward is banked at ×2 or 0; earlier waves are unaffected.
bestiary.coinWrong: A click alone does not toss it. An unrecognized drawing is not a spell; gestures cannot change the outcome once the toss starts.
bestiary.brewingShotDescription: Flies from a spirit to the cauldron and changes its temperature by {{delta}} °C on impact.
bestiary.brewingShotInteraction: It cannot be selected. Defeat the spirit to stop new shots and adjust heat after impact.
bestiary.brewingShotWrong: Spells cannot intercept a workshop bolt in flight. A bolt already fired reaches the cauldron even after the spirit dies.
bestiary.slowShotDescription: A slow bolt from a flying cube. It damages the crystal and leaves burning or frost on impact. It survives its shooter’s death.
bestiary.slowShotInteraction: Click the bolt itself and cast its listed countergesture before impact. Destroying it grants no stones.
bestiary.slowShotWrong: Other gestures without buffs do not destroy it. Echo and the novice wand can supply the counterspell. Splash damage and killing the shooter do not remove the bolt.
bestiary.fastShotDescription: The red cube’s very fast bolt deals a small amount of direct crystal damage.
bestiary.fastShotInteraction: Interrupt the red cube’s five-second preparation with one of its attack counters: V, square or Z.
bestiary.fastShotWrong: A fast bolt already fired cannot be selected or destroyed by any spell, including Echo or the novice wand.
bestiary.equipment.wand: Buy the wand in the shop and choose Equip. Its effects are fixed when crystal defense starts. Casting still requires selecting a game target.
bestiary.equipment.pot: Buy and equip the appearance in the shop. In the workshop, select the cauldron to heat, cool or stir with the usual gestures.
bestiary.equipment.crystal: Buy and select a color before entering. The main crystal and rim model select the same target: V clears frost, square clears burning, and circle disorients nearby enemies when surrounded.
bestiary.wandWrong: The wand itself is not a spell target. Combat effects work only in crystal defense; changing equipment in the profile does not alter a run already started.
bestiary.skinWrong: An appearance grants no extra damage, health or protection. Spells act on the selected cauldron or crystal by the usual rules.
bestiary.stonesDescription: Shop currency. The current arena wave's rewards are temporary; your profile balance contains only banked stones.
bestiary.stonesInteraction: Defeat enemies and clear waves. Use Next to bank rewards or risk the temporary amount with the coin. Defeat and exit lose only unbanked rewards.
bestiary.cardInteraction: Awarded after clearing the corresponding crystal-defense wave without cheats. Collected cards and counts appear under Achievements / cards.
bestiary.rewardWrong: This is a profile reward, not a spell target. No gesture creates or activates it directly.
bestiary.decoyIngredientDescription: An extra shelf material not used by any current recipe. A similar shape does not make it a substitute for another ingredient.
shop.potionSlotDescription: Permanently unlocks {{potionSlots}} slots for different potions in crystal defense.
shop.potionCopiesDescription: Start with {{potionCopies}} uses of each selected potion. Only one bottle of each type is consumed from storage.
arena.entryUpgraded: Choose {{range}} different potions. One bottle of each type is consumed; you receive {{copies}} uses per type.
arena.pendingLost: The unfinished wave's reward was lost. Previously banked stones remain safe.
bestiary.equipment.upgrade: A permanent crystal-defense upgrade. Applies automatically on your next entry; ×3 replaces ×2 instead of multiplying it.
bestiary.upgradeWrong: A preparation upgrade, not a spell target. No repeat purchase is needed; an ongoing run stays unchanged.
arena.enemyLifted: Cube lifted. Move the pointer over the table, then drop with a horizontal line.
arena.dropFirst: Drop the held cube with a horizontal line first.
arena.needCrowd: Circle works when a group of enemies surrounds the crystal.
arena.disorientWait: The disorientation spell is still recharging.
arena.bomberExploded: Purple cube detonated: only enemies took damage.
bestiary.arena.bomber: Runs quickly around the table, glows purple and never attacks the crystal. May appear when at least {{threshold}} opponents are alive. Select it and cast any recognized gesture: one cast detonates it for {{damage}} damage to enemies within {{radius}} units.
bestiary.bomberInteraction: Select the purple cube and perform any of the ten gestures. Its blast leaves the crystal unharmed but can kill enemies and split a giant.
bestiary.bomberWrong: This cube cannot be carried. Burning damage alone does not detonate it. Even lift and drop gestures cast directly at it trigger an explosion.
bestiary.carryInteraction: To deal damage, select the cube and use its counterspell. To move it, select it, draw a vertical line (3), move the pointer to a table position, then drop with a horizontal line (4). Lifting and falling cost no HP; existing burn damage continues. Echo and the beginner wand do not turn carrying into an attack.
bestiary.carryWrong: Lift (3) and drop (4) move this cube without direct damage; other nonmatching gestures do not hurt it. Only one cube can be held at a time. Echo, burning and splash can strengthen normal attacks.
spells.4.effect: Cancels ingredient carrying or lowers a held cube onto the table without fall damage.
spells.5.effect: Stirs the selected cauldron. On the selected arena crystal, disorients the three nearest enemies when surrounded; a cooldown applies.
